title: Walk or run in the rain?
question: Over the same distance, does running keep you drier than walking — and does a tailwind change the answer?
line: Three people cross the same 100 m street in steady rain: the walker (1.4 m/s), the runner (5 m/s) and you (set your own speed). Rain reaches you two ways. The TOP of you (head and shoulders, 0.15 m²)
